name: Jishou
source:
The original creator of the Karyuu school of fighting, [url=/c47202]Sakihiko's[/url] father.
He left the school to [url=/c47200]Iori[/url] while he started working as the town doctor.
He still comes around to check on the dojo from time to time.
translation:
The original creator of the Karyuu school of fighting, [url=/c47202]Sakihiko's[/url] father.
He left the school to [url=/c47200]Iori[/url] while he started working as the town doctor.
He still comes around to check on the dojo from time to time.
